histology: Acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplasia-related (AML-MR), relapsed/refractory; transformed from prior MDS (RCMD, IPSS-R high/very-high, diagnosed ~2019); with extramedullary myeloid sarcoma
stage: Relapsed/refractory AML-MR. Marrow ~85% blasts (June 2026); peripheral-blood blasts 58->82% (late June 2026); extramedullary right-thigh myeloid sarcoma on MRI (May 2026, adverse feature). Refractory to FLAG-IDA + venetoclax reinduction. Late relapse ~6 years after matched-sibling PBSC allo-HCT (~2020); pattern consistent with graft-versus-leukemia escape rather than graft failure.

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.value: aberrant, pending confirmation (NOT resolved in either direction). Pathogenic TP53 mutation reported on 2019 diagnostic NGS; 2026 relapse NGS reported NEGATIVE, but on a limited assay (LOD ~2% VAF, no copy-number/CNV detection, not MRD-grade). Discrepancy most plausibly subclonal loss, copy-loss, or a re-review artifact rather than true reversion. Working call: TP53-aberrant pending confirmation.
biomarkers.method: NGS (2019 diagnostic panel: pathogenic; 2026 Oncomine GX v2 relapse panel: negative, limited LOD/no CNV/not MRD)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Resolve the 2019-vs-2026 discrepancy WITHOUT collapsing it: retrieve the original 2019 variant identity + VAF, add p53 IHC and 17p (TP53) FISH, and determine the specific amino-acid change. A confirmed Y220C would open rezatapopt (variant-contingent); eprenetapopt is low-yield. Do not down-call to wild-type on the basis of a 2%-LOD/no-CNV panel alone.

biomarkers.name: TP53 Y220C (specific variant)
biomarkers.value: unknown / to be determined — Y220C status not established; therapy handle (rezatapopt) is contingent on it
biomarkers.method: NGS variant-level readout pending (contingent on TP53 confirmation above)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Variant-specific NGS to establish whether the TP53 aberration is Y220C. Y220C-positive would be actionable for the Y220C-selective reactivator rezatapopt; non-Y220C TP53 aberration would not.

biomarkers.name: HLA-A*02:01
biomarkers.value: unknown / pending retrieval. High-resolution HLA typing was performed ~2020 but the allele-level result is not in the records on hand (placeholder in the EHR).
biomarkers.method: HLA high-resolution typing (result to be pulled from the first-transplant / donor-registry chart)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Retrieve A*02:01 allele status. This is the master switch for HLA-A*02:01-restricted immunotherapy: HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T (e.g. TSC-100/101), WT1-C4, and PRAME approaches are gated on it. Eligibility for the primary reason this case was submitted hinges on this value.

biomarkers.name: HLA-A*24:02
biomarkers.method: HLA high-resolution typing (to be retrieved in parallel with A*02:01)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Check in parallel with A*02:01. If A*02:01-negative, A*24:02 opens an alternative WT1-siTCR lever; therefore both alleles must be resolved before foreclosing HLA-restricted immunotherapy.

biomarkers.name: HA-1 / HA-2 minor histocompatibility antigens (recipient and sibling donor)
biomarkers.value: unknown / pending for BOTH patient and sibling donor. HLA-identical siblings can still differ at HA-1/HA-2.
biomarkers.method: HA-1/HA-2 genotyping of recipient and donor (not yet performed)
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Genotype HA-1/HA-2 in both the patient and the HLA-identical sibling donor. HA-directed TCR-T (TSC-100/101) requires the specific mismatch of recipient HA-1(H)-positive / donor HA-1-negative (and is further gated on HLA-A*02:01). Do not assume eligibility or ineligibility until both are genotyped.

biomarkers.name: CD33
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Positivity confirmed qualitatively. REQUEST QUANTITATIVE (antigen-density) CD33 flow to support ADC/immunotoxin targeting decisions (gemtuzumab ozogamicin; dual CD33/CD123 strategies) — qualitative positivity does not establish the density that predicts ADC benefit.

biomarkers.name: CD123
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Positivity confirmed qualitatively. REQUEST QUANTITATIVE (antigen-density) CD123 flow to support CD123-directed therapy selection (tagraxofusp, pivekimab; dual CD33/CD123).

biomarkers.name: AML immunophenotype (supporting)
biomarkers.value: CD34+ (increased), CD13+, CD15+ (subset), CD117+ (variably increased), HLA-DR (variably decreased), CD38 decreased; negative CD4/CD5/CD7/CD14/CD16/CD19/CD56/CD64
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Documented myeloid immunophenotype supporting AML lineage; no aberrant lymphoid antigens flagged for alternative targeting.

biomarkers.name: FLT3
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Excludes FLT3 inhibitor labels (midostaurin, gilteritinib, quizartinib). Consider re-testing at relapse given clonal evolution, though 2026 panel did not report FLT3.

biomarkers.decision_resolution: Excludes ivosidenib/olutasidenib label. Reasonable to re-confirm at relapse.

biomarkers.name: IDH2
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Excludes enasidenib label. Reasonable to re-confirm at relapse.

biomarkers.name: JAK3
biomarkers.decision_resolution: VUS; not currently actionable. Re-classification would require variant-level review; no decision impact unless upgraded.

biomarkers.name: SMC3
biomarkers.decision_resolution: VUS in a cohesin-complex gene; not currently actionable.

biomarkers.name: Cytogenetics / karyotype
biomarkers.value: Complex, adverse-risk. 2019: complex karyotype with del(5q), del(7q), del(20q12), der(17)t(13;17) [17p], monosomy 13, others. 2026 relapse: gain of 5' MECOM, del(5q), del(7q), KMT2A amplification (4 copies), del(8cen), del(16q22). Shared del(5q)/del(7q) + TP53 founder across timepoints indicates evolution of the ORIGINAL clone transformed to AML (not a new/secondary or donor-derived leukemia).
biomarkers.method: karyotype / FISH (2019 and 2026); clonal-origin inference from shared lesions
biomarkers.decision_resolution: Confirm clonal origin with side-by-side 2019-vs-2026 comparison plus STR chimerism on SORTED CD34+ blasts (sex-matched sibling donor precludes XY-FISH). Obtain a full metaphase karyotype at relapse. MECOM rearrangement and KMT2A amplification are adverse and shape prognosis/trial eligibility.
